integrity: The universal statement is proved from the published exact PSL_2(q) criterion, elementary factorizations, and nonexceptional applications of Bang--Zsigmondy; bounded computation is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the PSL_2(q) branch of the finite-simple power-cograph classification.
It reduces but does not solve the remaining prime-extension primality questions.
An equivalent arithmetic reduction could exist in unindexed literature.
title: Prime extension-degree reduction for \(\mathrm{PSL}_2(q)\) power-cographs
